report - Generate a Markdown retrospective draft.

Usage:
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs report --session <file> --logs-dir <dir> --out <file>
  node scripts/retro-cli.mjs report --phase <name> --title <text> --out <file>

Options:
  -h, --help                  Show command help.
  --session <file>            Rollout or session JSONL file.
  --logs-dir <dir>            Directory containing stage logs.
  --artifacts-dir <dir>       Project root or evidence root.
  --skills-dir <dir>          Directory containing skill folders.
  --phase <name>              Optional phase label for the report.
  --title <text>              Title override.
  --out <file>                Output Markdown path.

Notes:
  - The generated report is a draft; read the cited artifacts before finalizing conclusions.
